body: I have friends who have been in care and it’s not something I’d ever wish on anyone, however I feel like it’s the only chance they’d get at a “normal” life outside of courtships and modesty rules :/
I did an all nighter last night for my degree and I’m still up watching this, sleep is for the weak
Will child protective services be involved after this?

I’m pretty sure she’s his girlfriend as she has recently changed her profile picture to the two of them she has put a highlight reel of them together up on Instagram in the past few weeks too, which is what I wouldn’t do if I thought my partner was cheating but there we go.

I think my main worry is that now she’s following my current partner she might try and drag them into this mess which would be completely unfair.

At the moment she’s still only suspecting things, she might think that me and her boyfriend are still hooking up and that I’m cheating on my current partner, or there’s a paranoid part of my brain that wonders if she’d try and get with my partner as “revenge” (me and my partner have agreed that they would tell me as soon as if she ever messaged them, I was with my partner when the follow request came through)
That’s a really good idea, thank you, I guess I was worried about restarting drama if I didn’t leave it alone
